dedupe_keys.name: vde fnn disturbance and availability statistics german electricity network interruptions and component failure data

description: VDE FNN supports German electricity network operators in recording availability, disturbances and damage in network operation to monitor supply reliability. Operators record data with two schemes: scheme A (availability) captures supply interruptions longer than one second for customers at low and medium voltage, from which availability indicators are derived; scheme B (disturbances) captures detailed disturbance events at medium, high and extra-high voltage, from which component indicators are derived as inputs to reliability calculations. VDE FNN evaluates both nationwide and publishes an annual disturbance and availability statistic for a cost contribution; tools include a recording program, an online portal for reporting and evaluation, and a checking and conversion program. The page, dated 8 July 2024, offers the rulebook (September 2024), recording guide (June 2024) and schemes A and B for recording from 2024 as Excel and PDF, with archived versions for earlier years. Coverage is German networks of participating operators. Reporting documents are free; the annual statistic is paid. Caveats: participation and detail depend on reporting operators, and raw event data are not public. Simulation uses are component failure rates and repair data for reliability and cascading failure models of distribution and transmission networks. Related records: data-bnetza-supply-interruption-statistics-germany gives the regulator's SAIDI statistics.
